name: pharmastock
description: PharmaStock — professional pharmacy inventory management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,gateway,auth,medicine,inventory,notification,sales,purchase,reporting "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix medicine-service" "npm run dev --prefix inventory-service" "npm run dev --prefix notification-service" "npm run dev --prefix sales-service" "npm run dev --prefix purchase-service" "npm run dev --prefix reporting-service"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix auth-service && npm run build --prefix medicine-service && npm run build --prefix inventory-service && npm run build --prefix notification-service && npm run build --prefix sales-service && npm run build --prefix purchase-service && npm run build --prefix reporting-service && npm run build --prefix gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix auth-service && npm run typecheck --prefix medicine-service && npm run typecheck --prefix inventory-service && npm run typecheck --prefix notification-service && npm run typecheck --prefix sales-service && npm run typecheck --prefix purchase-service && npm run typecheck --prefix reporting-service && npm run typecheck --prefix gateway
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix medicine-service && npm install --prefix inventory-service && npm install --prefix notification-service && npm install --prefix sales-service && npm install --prefix purchase-service && npm install --prefix reporting-service && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix tools/dev-seed && npm install
